name: React
testGuide: Use vitest (import { test, expect, vi } from "vitest") with @testing-library/react (render, screen, within) and @testing-library/user-event (await userEvent.click(...), await userEvent.type(...)). The environment is jsdom and cleanup runs after each test. Query by role, label or text like a user would. Only react, react-dom and those testing libraries are installed. Use vi.useFakeTimers() for time.
